description: Sets the person’s own words as lettering on a t-shirt — a name, a phrase, a team, a date — in one to three lines of up to 48 characters. Returns eight styles at once (an arch, a round seal, handwritten, stacked type, a typed label…), only their words, the shop’s dots as the ornament. Given `after` — a drawing_id it returned — it returns eight more styles for the same words. Given `photo` — the design_id of a drawn picture, made from a photo or from the person’s words — it sets the words with that picture (light shirts only).

after.description: A drawing_id from print_words: eight more styles for the same words (lines are then not needed).

lines.description: One to three lines of text, as they should read.

photo.description: The design_id of a drawn picture, from a photo or from words: the words are set with that picture — on light shirts only.

name: print_words
title: Print words on a shirt
